newsitem.title: USA: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - New York Times front page - Dec 3.

text.p: The New York Times reported the following stories on its front page Tuesday:

- United Nations Secretary-General Boutros Boutros-Ghali saw an important block of support break up when Africans were released from their pledge to support him against American efforts to find a new secretary general.

- The U.S. Supreme Court heard arguments focused on an agricultural marketing law from the New Deal era requiring companies that pack and ship a variety of products to contribute to industry-wide advertising campaigns.

- Gen. Colin Powell said he supported a government investigation into the illnesses reported by thousands of Gulf War veterans, while saying he knows of no evidence that the veterans had been exposed to chemical or biological weapons during the war.

- China is stirring anxiety among its neighbors as a new generation of political leaders give signals that they are willing to use military force, especially to put down the independence movement on Taiwan.
